title: A peak on a small budget
text: A team of 3, one month. 300 requests per second normally; 3× for 2 minutes from minute 2. Now there are 2 fixed API Server instances, and many requests fail at the peak. Error rate ≤ 1% and p99 ≤ 500 ms for the whole run, at most $800 a month, at most 6 complexity points.
hint: Count the instances first. The peak is 900 requests per second × 20 ms each = 18 in progress at one time. Each instance handles 8 at a time, so you need 3 instances, not 6. Autoscaling does not help here: a new machine takes 2 minutes to start and the peak lasts 2 minutes, so the machines are ready when the peak is over, and autoscaling costs 1 more complexity point. 3 fixed instances are enough.
